Putrajaya.label: Maintain current policy
Putrajaya.decision_objective: Continue existing policies and assess whether outcomes improve without intervention in Putrajaya.
Putrajaya.intervention_description: No new campaigns, programmes, or capital allocation. Monitor pressure and prosperity signals quarterly.
Putrajaya.evidence_supporting: Current pressure score 82/100; prosperity 54/100. Quadrant: Manage growth.
Putrajaya.evidence_gaps: No controlled comparison available to measure counterfactual outcome.
Putrajaya.expected_output: Baseline data collection; no change in visitor volume or distribution.
Putrajaya.intended_outcome: Preserve current conditions; detect natural trend changes.
Putrajaya.risk_mitigation: Low implementation risk. Risk: missed opportunity if pressure continues rising.
Putrajaya.monitoring_kpi: Quarterly pressure score; state CPI YoY; visitor growth rate

Putrajaya.label: Demand management
Putrajaya.decision_objective: Reduce peak-period concentration in Putrajaya by shifting promotion to shoulder periods.
Putrajaya.target_population: Domestic leisure travellers; tourism operators in peak vs off-peak segments
Putrajaya.intervention_description: Shift 10–20% of promotion budget from peak quarters (Q1, Q4) to Q2–Q3. Introduce shoulder-period pricing incentives and package deals. Coordinate with accommodation and transport operators.
Putrajaya.responsible_organisation: Tourism Malaysia / State Tourism Authority / MOTAC
Putrajaya.evidence_supporting: Visitor growth +23.1% YoY. Pressure 82/100. Seasonal concentration evident from quarterly DOSM data.
Putrajaya.evidence_gaps: No state-level seasonality breakdown available in current DOSM extract. Accommodation occupancy data not state-disaggregated.
Putrajaya.expected_output: 10–20% shift in booking distribution from peak to shoulder quarters.
Putrajaya.intended_outcome: Reduced peak-period pressure; steadier accommodation and service load; improved operator viability.
Putrajaya.risk_mitigation: Risk: promotion shifting may displace demand to adjacent states rather than redistribute. Monitor neighbouring states. Mitigation: coordinated multi-state campaign.
Putrajaya.monitoring_kpi: Quarterly visitor share by season; accommodation occupancy rate peak vs off-peak; state CPI restaurant/accommodation index

Putrajaya.label: Capacity and destination readiness
Putrajaya.decision_objective: Increase Putrajaya's ability to absorb demand without declining visitor or resident experience.
Putrajaya.intervention_description: Fund accommodation capacity review and targeted capacity upgrades. Improve transport connectivity and public facilities. Prioritise digital infrastructure and emergency readiness.
Putrajaya.responsible_organisation: State Government / Local Authority / MOTAC / KPKT
Putrajaya.evidence_supporting: Visitors/100 residents: 2591.8. Pressure 82/100. Capacity indicators not available at state level in current DOSM extract. This is an evidence gap.
Putrajaya.evidence_gaps: No accommodation occupancy, transport load, or facility-readiness data available at state level in this extract. Capacity assessment requires separate data collection.
Putrajaya.expected_output: Increased accommodation capacity; improved public facilities; enhanced transport connectivity.
Putrajaya.intended_outcome: Pressure score reduction; improved destination experience; lower risk of resident cost impact.
Putrajaya.risk_mitigation: Risk: capital investment may induce additional demand rather than relieving pressure. Mitigation: pair with demand management measures. Monitor resident sentiment.
Putrajaya.monitoring_kpi: Pressure score; accommodation capacity count; transport peak load; public facility satisfaction survey

Putrajaya.label: Local business and community benefit
Putrajaya.decision_objective: Increase the share of tourism expenditure captured by local businesses and communities in Putrajaya.
Putrajaya.target_population: Local SMEs, community enterprises, lower-income residents in tourism areas
Putrajaya.intervention_description: Launch a local-supplier onboarding programme for tourism operators. Provide SME grants for tourism product development. Introduce local-procurement requirements for MOTAC-funded programmes. Support community-based tourism products.
Putrajaya.responsible_organisation: MOTAC / SME Corp / State Economic Development Corporation
Putrajaya.evidence_supporting: Tourist overnight mix 28.8%. Prosperity potential 54/100. DOSM 2025 shows 36.9% of domestic spend on shopping, an opportunity for local capture.
Putrajaya.evidence_gaps: No local business participation rate, local procurement share, or community income data available. Community-benefit outcome requires separate monitoring design.
Putrajaya.expected_output: Number of local businesses enrolled; local procurement share measured.
Putrajaya.intended_outcome: Increased tourism expenditure captured locally; improved tourism-linked employment quality; stronger community support for tourism.
Putrajaya.risk_mitigation: Risk: benefit may concentrate in already-established businesses rather than new entrants. Mitigation: eligibility criteria targeting new or micro enterprises.
Putrajaya.monitoring_kpi: Local business participation rate; local procurement share; tourism employment; resident satisfaction index

Putrajaya.label: Combined portfolio
Putrajaya.decision_objective: Balance demand management, capacity investment, and local-value improvement simultaneously in Putrajaya.
Putrajaya.target_population: All tourism stakeholders; prioritise under-served communities and areas with capacity gaps
Putrajaya.intervention_description: Implement a sequenced portfolio: (1) immediate demand shift to shoulder periods; (2) targeted capacity investment in identified bottlenecks; (3) SME onboarding and local-supplier development. Coordinate under a single state tourism action plan.
Putrajaya.responsible_organisation: MOTAC (lead) / State Tourism Authority / Local Authority / SME Corp
Putrajaya.evidence_supporting: Quadrant Manage growth. Pressure 82/100, Prosperity 54/100. Combined approach justified where single-lever interventions alone are insufficient.
Putrajaya.evidence_gaps: Causal impact of combined interventions cannot be separated. Requires a pre-specified measurement plan with baseline and comparison group.
Putrajaya.expected_output: Multi-lever action plan adopted; all three programme streams activated and monitored.
Putrajaya.intended_outcome: Sustained reduction in pressure score; improvement in prosperity potential; measurable local-benefit capture.
Putrajaya.risk_mitigation: Risk: implementation complexity and coordination failure. Mitigation: appoint a single accountable programme manager; set quarterly milestones and go/no-go decision points.
Putrajaya.monitoring_kpi: Pressure score; prosperity score; local business participation; seasonal distribution index; resident sentiment

Johor.target_population: All tourism stakeholders; prioritise under-served communities and areas with capacity gaps
Johor.intervention_description: Implement a sequenced portfolio: (1) immediate demand shift to shoulder periods; (2) targeted capacity investment in identified bottlenecks; (3) SME onboarding and local-supplier development. Coordinate under a single state tourism action plan.
Johor.responsible_organisation: MOTAC (lead) / State Tourism Authority / Local Authority / SME Corp
Johor.evidence_supporting: Quadrant Build readiness. Pressure 17/100, Prosperity 36/100. Combined approach justified where single-lever interventions alone are insufficient.
Johor.evidence_gaps: Causal impact of combined interventions cannot be separated. Requires a pre-specified measurement plan with baseline and comparison group.
Johor.expected_output: Multi-lever action plan adopted; all three programme streams activated and monitored.
Johor.intended_outcome: Sustained reduction in pressure score; improvement in prosperity potential; measurable local-benefit capture.
Johor.risk_mitigation: Risk: implementation complexity and coordination failure. Mitigation: appoint a single accountable programme manager; set quarterly milestones and go/no-go decision points.
Johor.monitoring_kpi: Pressure score; prosperity score; local business participation; seasonal distribution index; resident sentiment

Selangor.label: Maintain current policy
Selangor.decision_objective: Continue existing policies and assess whether outcomes improve without intervention in Selangor.
Selangor.intervention_description: No new campaigns, programmes, or capital allocation. Monitor pressure and prosperity signals quarterly.
Selangor.evidence_supporting: Current pressure score 15/100; prosperity 3/100. Quadrant: Build readiness.
Selangor.evidence_gaps: No controlled comparison available to measure counterfactual outcome.
Selangor.expected_output: Baseline data collection; no change in visitor volume or distribution.
Selangor.intended_outcome: Preserve current conditions; detect natural trend changes.
Selangor.risk_mitigation: Low implementation risk. Risk: missed opportunity if pressure continues rising.
Selangor.monitoring_kpi: Quarterly pressure score; state CPI YoY; visitor growth rate

Selangor.label: Demand management
Selangor.decision_objective: Reduce peak-period concentration in Selangor by shifting promotion to shoulder periods.
Selangor.target_population: Domestic leisure travellers; tourism operators in peak vs off-peak segments
Selangor.intervention_description: Shift 10–20% of promotion budget from peak quarters (Q1, Q4) to Q2–Q3. Introduce shoulder-period pricing incentives and package deals. Coordinate with accommodation and transport operators.
Selangor.responsible_organisation: Tourism Malaysia / State Tourism Authority / MOTAC
Selangor.evidence_supporting: Visitor growth +5.6% YoY. Pressure 15/100. Seasonal concentration evident from quarterly DOSM data.
Selangor.evidence_gaps: No state-level seasonality breakdown available in current DOSM extract. Accommodation occupancy data not state-disaggregated.
Selangor.expected_output: 10–20% shift in booking distribution from peak to shoulder quarters.
Selangor.intended_outcome: Reduced peak-period pressure; steadier accommodation and service load; improved operator viability.
Selangor.risk_mitigation: Risk: promotion shifting may displace demand to adjacent states rather than redistribute. Monitor neighbouring states. Mitigation: coordinated multi-state campaign.
Selangor.monitoring_kpi: Quarterly visitor share by season; accommodation occupancy rate peak vs off-peak; state CPI restaurant/accommodation index

Selangor.label: Capacity and destination readiness
Selangor.decision_objective: Increase Selangor's ability to absorb demand without declining visitor or resident experience.
Selangor.intervention_description: Fund accommodation capacity review and targeted capacity upgrades. Improve transport connectivity and public facilities. Prioritise digital infrastructure and emergency readiness.
Selangor.responsible_organisation: State Government / Local Authority / MOTAC / KPKT
Selangor.evidence_supporting: Visitors/100 residents: 488.0. Pressure 15/100. Capacity indicators not available at state level in current DOSM extract. This is an evidence gap.
Selangor.evidence_gaps: No accommodation occupancy, transport load, or facility-readiness data available at state level in this extract. Capacity assessment requires separate data collection.
Selangor.expected_output: Increased accommodation capacity; improved public facilities; enhanced transport connectivity.
Selangor.intended_outcome: Pressure score reduction; improved destination experience; lower risk of resident cost impact.
Selangor.risk_mitigation: Risk: capital investment may induce additional demand rather than relieving pressure. Mitigation: pair with demand management measures. Monitor resident sentiment.
Selangor.monitoring_kpi: Pressure score; accommodation capacity count; transport peak load; public facility satisfaction survey

Selangor.label: Local business and community benefit
Selangor.decision_objective: Increase the share of tourism expenditure captured by local businesses and communities in Selangor.
Selangor.target_population: Local SMEs, community enterprises, lower-income residents in tourism areas
Selangor.intervention_description: Launch a local-supplier onboarding programme for tourism operators. Provide SME grants for tourism product development. Introduce local-procurement requirements for MOTAC-funded programmes. Support community-based tourism products.
Selangor.responsible_organisation: MOTAC / SME Corp / State Economic Development Corporation
Selangor.evidence_supporting: Tourist overnight mix 29.1%. Prosperity potential 3/100. DOSM 2025 shows 36.9% of domestic spend on shopping, an opportunity for local capture.
Selangor.evidence_gaps: No local business participation rate, local procurement share, or community income data available. Community-benefit outcome requires separate monitoring design.
Selangor.expected_output: Number of local businesses enrolled; local procurement share measured.
Selangor.intended_outcome: Increased tourism expenditure captured locally; improved tourism-linked employment quality; stronger community support for tourism.
Selangor.risk_mitigation: Risk: benefit may concentrate in already-established businesses rather than new entrants. Mitigation: eligibility criteria targeting new or micro enterprises.
Selangor.monitoring_kpi: Local business participation rate; local procurement share; tourism employment; resident satisfaction index

decision_register.decision_question: Should Putrajaya be excluded from the Q4 2026 national tourism promotion campaign?
options_considered: Option 0: Include in campaign (maintain current policy)
Option 1: Exclude from broad campaign, redirect budget to shoulder-period incentives
Option 2: Exclude and fund capacity audit first
decision_register.selected_option: Option 1: Exclude from broad campaign, redirect to shoulder-period incentives
decision_register.reason_for_selection: Pressure score 82/100 indicates high demand-intensity risk. Visitor-to-resident ratio 2,591/100 is the highest in Malaysia. Broad campaign risks worsening peak pressure without commensurate benefit.
assumptions: Redirected promotion to shoulder periods will shift, not simply add, demand.
Resident cost pressure partly correlates with visitor concentration.
Capacity constraints are binding at current visitor-to-resident ratio.
known_limitations: No accommodation occupancy data at state level to confirm capacity stress.
CPI is general cost-of-living; tourism causality not established.
No carrying-capacity study available for Putrajaya.

data_dictionary.name: Domestic Visitors 2025
data_dictionary.definition: Total number of domestic visitor arrivals in the reference period. A visitor is a person who travels outside their usual environment for any purpose.

data_dictionary.name: Domestic Tourists (Overnight Visitors) 2025
data_dictionary.definition: Domestic visitors who stayed at least one night at the destination. Excludes same-day excursionists.

data_dictionary.name: Visitor Growth Year-on-Year
data_dictionary.definition: Percentage change in total domestic visitors compared to the same period of the prior year. Formula: (current − prior) / prior × 100.

data_dictionary.name: Overnight Tourist Mix
data_dictionary.definition: Share of total domestic visitors who stayed overnight. Formula: overnight tourists / total visitors × 100.

data_dictionary.name: Visitors per 100 Residents
data_dictionary.definition: Ratio of total domestic visitors to the resident population, expressed per 100 residents. A screening measure of demand intensity. Not a carrying-capacity limit.

data_dictionary.name: State CPI Year-on-Year
data_dictionary.definition: Year-on-year change in the state-level Consumer Price Index (overall division, COICOP 2-digit). Measured from the same month of the prior year.

data_dictionary.name: Destination Pressure Index
data_dictionary.definition: Transparent composite screening index (0–100) combining visitor density (50%), visitor growth (30%), and state CPI (20%). A high score is a reason to investigate, not an official capacity limit.

data_dictionary.name: Prosperity Potential Index
data_dictionary.definition: Transparent composite screening index (0–100) combining visitor density (35%), visitor growth (30%), and overnight tourist mix (35%). Measures opportunity for high-value tourism capture.

data_dictionary.name: Visitor Demand Forecast
data_dictionary.definition: Model-generated point estimate of quarterly domestic visitors. Produced by an Ensemble of Damped ETS + AutoReg models, chosen by 4-quarter holdout RMSE.

data_dictionary.name: Environmental Stress Index
data_dictionary.definition: Normalised index (0–100) of national-level air pollutant concentrations relative to a baseline mean. Higher = greater deviation from baseline. National aggregate only; not state-level.
